title: The Ingredients Store and Vantage Personal Care partner to expand digital access to ingredients
summary: The partnership brings Vantage’s speciality ingredients and natural oils to The Ingredients Store’s fast-growing digital platform, supporting indie brands, formulators and manufacturers seeking easier access to high-quality materials

extraction.key_fact: 두 회사가 제휴해 특수 원료와 천연 오일을 디지털 플랫폼에서 구할 수 있게 한다.
